system.description:
You methodically sharpen every tool you find yourself in possession of. Over the course of a short rest, you take your Executioners Instrument and one weapon from each willing allied creature and work to sharpen or balance them. At the conclusion of your rest, the first time you roll initiative, all of your sharpened weapons come to fruition. Until the conclusion of this combat, you gain a rank of Mastery to your [Weapon Damage]. This increases to two ranks of Mastery at 11th level.

Once you sharpen weapons in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete another rest.
